recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16314 unless the work group reopens the broader Device/DeviceDefinition modeling question in a new issue.
issue_request: FHIR-16314 asked to keep Device Instance and Device Kind as separate concepts instead of combining them into one resource with profiles. Jira is Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification; later comments and the OO vote trail show the submitter considered the Jira no longer needed because FHIR already had separate Device and DeviceDefinition resources.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-16314 was found on the relevant Device or DeviceDefinition source paths. The substantive split was already present through earlier DeviceDefinition work, beginning with the 2018 commit that changed Device and added DeviceDefinition.
additional_context: OO Confluence minutes from 2020-08-31 and 2020-09-03 list FHIR-16314 in the Healthcare Product/Device block-vote trail and show it as pulled. Jira comments from 2019 and 2020 say the current state already had Device and DeviceDefinition and that the submitter considered the Jira unnecessary. Later community search found no conflicting FHIR-16314-specific discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active current build includes both Device and DeviceDefinition, Device.definition canonically references DeviceDefinition, and DeviceDefinition narrative and conformance text describe a type/kind/model definition distinct from an actual Device instance.

related_jiras.note: Listed near FHIR-16314 in the same OO Device/Definition block-vote agenda as a separate ItemInstance question, but not needed to decide this seed.
